name: DoorDash DashPass

fastest.text: In the DoorDash app or on doordash.com, tap the account icon → Manage DashPass → Cancel Membership, then Cancel DashPass.

steps: Open the DoorDash app, or sign in at doordash.com.
Tap the account icon, then Manage DashPass.
Tap Cancel Membership, choose a reason, then select Cancel DashPass.
Select Got it. DoorDash emails you a confirmation.
note: Only need a break? On the same Manage DashPass page you can select Pause Membership instead.

faq.a: At least 24 hours before your next scheduled payment. Cancel later than that and you're charged for the next period.

faq.q: When do my DashPass benefits end?
faq.a: On a paid plan, at the end of the current billing period. On a free trial, as soon as you cancel.

faq.q: Can I pause instead of cancelling?
faq.a: Yes. On the Manage DashPass page, select Pause Membership, then Pause DashPass to confirm.
